title: phyllodoce caerulea subsp. aleutica
intro: Phyllodoce caerulea subsp. aleutica, commonly known as the Aleutian blue mountain heath, is a plant species within the heath family (Ericaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in alleviating respiratory issues such as colds and bronchitis. The health benefits of Phyllodoce caerulea subsp. aleutica include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to ease congestion and promote a productive cough. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which possess antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
